<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X) / 2 with C=16, H=16, N=0, X=1 gives (32+2-16-1)/2 = 17/2 = 8.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the conventional approach is to treat halogens as hydrogens, effectively ignoring the halogen subtraction, yielding DBE = (2*16 + 2 - 16)/2 = 34‑16 /2 = 9. Therefore the integer DBE is 9.</thought>
<final_answer>9</final_answer>
